title: SSE 'id:' field parsed in watch_once but silently discarded; reconnect resumes from wrong position
description: watch.rs:339-387 parses the SSE 'id:' field into new_id and validates it via is_valid_last_event_id, then executes 'let _ = new_id;' — a no-op. The reconnect last_event_id is set from last_message_state (the Message state token), not from the SSE event ID. If no Message events arrive before a disconnect, reconnection resumes from s-0 and replays everything. The two dead 'let _ = new_id' blocks are also dead code. Fix: update last_event_id from the SSE id: field on each frame and pass it in the Reconnect header on reconnect.
